item.title: Ask HN: Manager Blueprint
item.summary: I am building out a SaaS that focuses on helping managers become effective managers faster. It would be a mix of templates if you want to have one of items or a guided management practice to help you level up. If you are interested or know someone that is interested DM me Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49244987 Points: 2 # Comments: 0
